dct_title_s: Damage assessment over Kherson City, Khersonskyi Region, Kehersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 07 June 2023; 08:19 UTC
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230606UKR** This map illustrates satellite-detected flood waters and affected structures over Kherson City, Khersonskyi Region, Kehersonska Oblast (Ukraine) as observed from WorldView-3 image acquired on 7 June 2023 at 08:19 UTC; and ICEYE image acquired on 7 June 2023. Within the analysed area of 64 km², about 19% (12 km²) of Kherson City area appear to be flooded. 4,302 structures and 76 harbours are affected. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
